title: Efficacy and Safety of Fluvastatin or Valsartan and Their Combination in Dyslipidemic Patients With Hypertension and Endothelial Dysfunction
brief_summary: Patients with mild to moderate hypertension, dyslipidemia (imbalanced blood lipids) and decreased vascular dilatation, receiving a cholesterol lowering diet were given either valsartan or fluvastatin for 8 weeks. At week 8 all patients were administered a combination treatment with valsartan 160 mg and fluvastatin 80 mg.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Arterial hypertension
* Dyslipidemia
* Cholesterol lowering diet

Exclusion Criteria:

* Constant antihypertensive treatment
* Diabetes mellitus
* Myocardial infarction or stroke in the previous 3 months

Other inclusion and exclusion criteria may apply
